lines:
### Definitions & notes
- **Baseline / legacy VR** = each radiologist's own pre-Mosaic efficiency on legacy voice recognition. Efficiency % change = Mosaic efficiency vs. that baseline (TBWU per hour). Implied read-time savings is the same comparison expressed as time per exam (negative = less time per exam).
- **% of RPCE exams** (Reporting / Drafting / Capture) = share of RPCE-sourced exams read in Mosaic, same +0.02 adjustment as the PowerBI report.
- **Drafting** efficiency is restricted to CR/CT exams on both the Mosaic and baseline side (intentional, documented divergence from the PowerBI page).
- **Capacity** compares RPWU produced per on-shift hour with the radiologist's shift baseline. By default only shifts with a matched baseline are included, as in PowerBI; a large share of shifts have no matched baseline -- see the coverage badge.
- **Utilization** = reading time / shift time, capped at 100%. Check *exams with valid read time* before trusting a slice: dictation timestamps are missing for some practices.
- Outlier exams are excluded from efficiency (PowerBI default). The current month is partial in trend lines.

# Draftable, Undrafted -- why exams are not AI-drafted
Every Mosaic exam that *could* have been drafted, classified by why it was or was not. Follows the global **Period**, **Local Region** and **Team Rolled Up** filters; the weekly trend shows full history.

lines:
### What is holding drafting back
- **Radiologist not enabled** (consent declined, ops declined, or *incomplete process* -- the radiologist drafted under 10% of that model's exams that week) is the largest bucket. *Incomplete process* alone is the single biggest lever: these radiologists have drafting but are not using it consistently.
- **Enabled, draft not used** (radiologist and practice both live, exam opened without a draft) is the workflow / product bucket. *Opened >5 min* means the draft had time to arrive but was not used; *opened <5 min* points to draft latency.
- **Practice not enabled** is small: it only covers CT Chest / CT Spine exams at practices not yet live on those models.
- Use the tables below to find where each bucket concentrates (region, team, model, radiologist).

### Definitions & notes
- **Draftable** = Mosaic exams on drafting-eligible procedure codes. Each exam is classified once, first match wins: Drafted > Rad declined > Ops declined > Incomplete process > Practice not enabled > Never opened > Opened <5 min > Opened >5 min. % = share of all draftable exams (Drafted included), as in PowerBI's *Category % of Draftable*.
- Same source as the PowerBI Volume report's Draftable page (daily snapshot, refreshed 7am CT). Completed Mon-Sun weeks only, so the current week is not shown. XR/MSK and the CT models switch on per radiologist per week; Do-Not-Launch radiologists are excluded.
- **Local Region** here is PowerBI's Draftable mapping, which places a few teams (RP Florida West, RAA, Lakefront Imaging) in a different region than the other pages. **Managing Practice** does not apply to this page.
